claims: McNeese State University is located in Lake Charles, Louisiana.
McNeese State University is located in the southwestern part of Louisiana near the Texas border.
McNeese State University is a public university.
McNeese State University has a 122-acre main campus.
McNeese State University's main campus is in a region often referred to as the "Lake Area".
McNeese State University is roughly 210 miles from New Orleans.
McNeese State University is roughly 145 miles from Houston.
McNeese State University's campus is situated on the bank of Lake Charles.
